runs.name: Alliant Energy Corporation; Nasdaq LNT, SEC CIK 0000352541, 10-K filer; a regulated utility holding company in Madison, Wisconsin, electric and gas service to about 1,010,000 electric and 435,000 gas customers through IPL (Iowa) and WPL (Wisconsin), with a 16% interest in ATC under AEF; IPL left its steam business after 2025-12-31; no rename, merger, spin-off or split in the 8-Ks since June 2025; the 10-K names no SEC-filing rival, WEC Energy, MGE Energy and Xcel Energy chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR AND ABOVE THE TOP OF THE RANGE
runs.entry: Price **$68.32** (close 2026-10-16, `tools/run.py` quote source, aggregator, flagged). Shares 259,284,699 outstanding at 2026-06-30 (10-Q 0000352541-26-000043, `Screens/cover_shares.py`), no treasury line, no later filing changing the count; 25.58M shares sold forward for $1,737M and not yet issued (10-Q Note 5), shown beside. Sovereign **5.43%**, the US Treasury 30-year par yield (issuing authority), the earnings currency being the US dollar. Read from the 10-K for 2025 (0000352541-26-000007), the Q2 2026 10-Q, the 2026 proxy (0000352541-26-000025), the Q2 2026 release (8-K 0000352541-26-000042), the 8-K of 2026-08-21, the 10-Ks for 2022 and 2019 for the earlier cycle, and the XBRL balance sheets 2016 to 2025, 2025 and 2024 checked to the filed statements. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: two rate-regulated, obligation-to-serve utilities; customers cannot choose their supplier; authorized equity returns 9.34% to 12.23% at IPL and 9.80% at WPL, with earnings sharing above them. **Q2 IN**: a legal franchise money cannot attack, its ordinary regulated return carried to Q3 as the regulated exception; return on equity 10.0% to 11.9% every year 2017 to 2025; comparators WEC, MGE and Xcel (named in the 10-K as West Riverside co-owners, and Xcel) all 9.4% to 13.0%, Alliant in the middle; MidAmerican flagged, not read; the compact risk carried to Q9. **Q3 weighs against**: about 6.8% (2020) and 6.5% (2025) on capital before interest after tax, about 5.9% on the capital added 2020 to 2025 against the 5.43% Treasury; debt 56% to 62% of capital. **Q4 no STOP, weighs against**: $453M to $628M a year of sold-receivable collections booked in investing and recast into operating cash (`tools/run.py` misses this, its owner-earnings columns wrong for the name); no goodwill; regulatory assets $2.27B, about 31% of equity; EPS guidance reaffirmed each quarter and an adjusted EPS featured beside GAAP. **Q5 integrity IN, ability weighs for, modestly**: no restatement, investigation or proceeding of note, Deloitte since 2002; the CEO owns about $2.3M of stock against $9.0M of 2025 pay; the WPL solar program about $205M over estimate. **Q6 weighs against on both parts**, no acquisition or all-stock deal: a dividend payout set at 60% to 70% of earnings and refinanced by standing issuance (shares 227.69M in January 2017 to 259.28M, about 25% up counting the forward sales, up to $2.4B more planned); the bonus 70% on adjusted EPS, pay on earnings growth and capacity installed with no capital charge. **Q7 OUT**: owner cash 2021 to 2025 with depreciation as maintenance, central by (e), **$969M a year all-equity** (interest added back at the 21% federal rate, a CONVENTION of the run), $670M equity only; after all spending negative every year 2017 to 2025 (-$154M all-equity, -$453M equity); shown growth 20.50% a year cut by (f) to the 4.42% sales growth; net debt $12,283M; value range **$17.87 to $21.48 a share all-equity** (equity-only $34.97 to $47.59), the growth case the bottom because the growth bought is worth less than its cost; expected return 3.23% to 3.60% at the price, 4.65% in a case the text does not admit; fair price **-$16.69 all-equity, not positive** (-$9.09 with the forward stock settled), **$17.10 equity-only**. Contamination declared by the analyst: AQN commit subjects in the opening git log, AYI and ARCB research folders in the status listing, a memory-index line; a filter of `Test Runs/` names on LNT and Alliant before any fetch, which returned nothing; none used. Write-early departures declared: Q3 with Q4 and Q5 with Q6 committed together; the Q7 script first run while Q1 to Q4 were open, then headed COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE. Commits caed2750 (template), 4f8e8974 (Step 0, Q1), 662d8b83 (Q2), 1246fe32 (Q3 with Q4), fcc59194 (Q5 with Q6), c4b0a909 (Q7, after the stop, self-audit, notes). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's check 66 ids, 58 fragments, no problem; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_check.py` no E-id, no missing id, 79 quoted fragments within reach of an id, 12 flagged by the parser and read by hand as quotations from filings or framework wording attributed to the framework, the row's own fragment verified beside each, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) specific (e) against (f), which wins when the cap cuts growth while its full spending is still charged; (2) the all-equity basis at a 10% floor values any leveraged regulated utility below its debt at any price; (3) section E's tax specific does not fit tax credits the commissions pass to customers. Not armed: all-equity fair not positive and no organic-pair figure. Could not get: MidAmerican's figures, WEC's 2018 equity, the 10-Q's own finance-lease figure (the 10-K's $190M used).
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor and above the top of the range (Alliant Energy Corporation, Nasdaq LNT; regulated electric and gas utilities IPL in Iowa and WPL in Wisconsin; Q1 IN; Q2 IN as the regulated exception, return on equity 10.0% to 11.9% every year 2017 to 2025 beside WEC, MGE and Xcel; Q3 against, about 5.9% on added capital; Q4 no STOP, against, sold-receivable collections recast; Q5 integrity IN, ability for, modestly; Q6 against, ratio dividend refinanced by standing issuance; owner cash $969M a year all-equity after maintenance, negative after all spending every year; value range $17.87 to $21.48 all-equity at $68.32, fair -$16.69 all-equity, not positive, $17.10 equity-only; no citation slip; not held; not armed; framework gaps for the operator: (e) against (f), the all-equity floor at a leveraged utility, pass-through tax credits)
